title: Accurate Torque Ripple Measurement for PMSM
publisher: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
author: Greg Heins; Mark Thiele; Travis Brown
locator: Measurement-system dynamics, torque transducer bandwidth/resolution, smooth load and calibration requirements
notes: Peer-reviewed measurement study on a 1 hp axial-flux PMSM. It emphasizes that shaft torque is not automatically identical to air-gap torque; accurate ripple measurements require known mechanical dynamics, suitable sensors, smooth loading and calibration. The rig is a research example, not a CNC rotary-axis acceptance procedure.
